zh.headline: OpenAI 估值 1.25 万亿，Anthropic IPO 遇阻
headline_alt: 两家开源巨模同日发布，西方开源榜易主
AI 资本热与使用支出降温同时出现
zh.observation: 今天的核心信号是"资本热度与使用支出开始脱钩"：OpenAI 以 1.25 万亿美元估值继续吸金，Anthropic 的 IPO 定价却被买方压到 1.1 万亿，而 Ramp 数据显示企业 AI 支出已经停滞——降价和成本管控正在抵消调用量的增长。技术侧同一天出现两个西方开源巨模（Inkling 2 Small 与 Ripple-65B），加上 TorchTPU 打通 PyTorch 与 TPU，权重与硬件的可选择性都在变多。更值得警惕的是 METR 的审计结论：AI 辅助研发已让 Anthropic 的迭代速度约翻倍，而关键证据被涂黑，这意味着"自我加速"正在从推测变成需要外部审计能力的基础设施问题。对开发者而言，短期最实际的变化是推理成本继续下探（Gemini Omni 降价 30%、Together Compiler 提速 2.6 倍），但开源模型在安全能力上的主动裁剪，会让本地部署的选型变得更复杂。

items.title: OpenAI 再融 110 亿美元，估值升至 1.25 万亿美元
items.desc: 新一轮融资尚未关闭，预计数周内完成；距 3 月 8520 亿美元估值仅半年多。
items.value: 头部模型公司的资本壁垒进一步拉高，创业公司融资参照系被重置

items.title: Anthropic IPO 估值预期从 1.5 万亿下探至 1.1 万亿
items.desc: 投资者在 AI 板块抛售中压价，承销方与买方就定价分歧明显。
items.value: 一级市场对模型公司的定价开始分化，泡沫论获得数据支撑

items.title: Ramp 数据：AI 使用量仍在涨，但企业支出停滞
items.desc: 降价与成本管控抵消了调用增长，直接挑战"AI 超高速增长"的投资假设。
items.value: 按 token 计费的产品需重新评估 ARPU 与增长模型

items.title: Perplexity 推出常驻 Agent「Teammates」
items.desc: Agent 在独立虚拟机上持续推进长期项目，需 200 美元/月 Max 套餐，定价高于 OpenAI、Anthropic 同类产品。
items.value: 常驻 Agent 赛道拥挤，定价与任务持续性成为差异化点

items.title: Meta 为 Muse Agent 推出 Spaces
items.desc: 用户可在 Muse 内生成购物中心、学校看板、音乐追踪器等定制化 App 式界面并直接交互。
items.value: Agent 从对话走向"生成小型应用"，是产品形态的新样本

items.title: 美国中期选举后，AI 与数据中心成政治焦点
items.desc: 民主党启动对 SpaceXAI、Meta、苹果的国会调查；41 项数据中心公投中 40 项通过限制性条款。
items.value: 算力扩张的合规与社区阻力将实质影响训练与推理成本

items.title: OpenAI 宣布数据中心项目不再对官员使用 NDA
items.desc: 中期选举后作出社区承诺，回应外界对以保密协议隐藏谈判的批评。
items.value: 数据中心落地流程透明化，或成行业默认做法

items.title: 微软收缩与 Oracle 的 AI 云容量租用协议
items.desc: 此前为缓解算力缺口签下的大单开始退坡。
items.value: 云算力供需出现松动信号，影响 GPU 租赁定价预期

items.title: Palo Alto Networks 洽谈以 5 亿美元收购 Agent 安全公司 Clutch
items.desc: Clutch 上轮估值仅 8500 万美元。
items.value: Agent 安全成为独立品类，被大厂溢价收购验证需求

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber，可攻防一体
items.desc: 在 Firefox 中发现 81 个此前未知漏洞，在 Linux 内核中构造出 948 个可用 exploit，并给出补丁建议。
items.value: 安全审计与漏洞挖掘的工作流将被重构，防守方需重新评估威胁模型

items.title: Google 发布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.desc: 视频生成延长至 15 秒，支持多轮对话式编辑，720p 价格降至每秒 0.07 美元，降幅 30%。
items.value: 视频生成单位成本继续下探，短剧、广告类应用毛利空间打开

items.title: METR 审计称 Anthropic 或已于 7 月越过自身 AI 加速预警线
items.desc: 11 周审计显示其模型研发速度约翻倍，其中约 80% 加速来自 AI 辅助研究；关键证据被 Anthropic 涂黑。
items.value: AI 加速 AI 研发从传闻变为可审计数据，安全承诺的可验证性受质疑

items.title: 欧盟文本水印新规落地，OpenAI textGrain 恐难达标
items.desc: 测试显示水印在文本被再次编辑或长度低于 150 词时经常失效，且缺乏明确法律基准。
items.value: 合规水印方案尚不成熟，出海产品的文本溯源能力需自建

items.title: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Small：594B MoE，17B 激活
items.desc: Artificial Analysis 智能指数 31 分，支持图像输入与可变推理强度，计划以 Apache 2.0 开放权重，可在 Tinker 上运行。
items.value: 西方开源权重模型新上限，但 token 消耗显著上升需权衡成本

items.title: OpenAI 发布 BioBasicsBench
items.desc: 100 项任务，衡量 Agent 解读原始实验数据、处理日常湿实验的能力。
items.value: 为"AI 做实验"提供可复现评测，生物类 Agent 有了基准

items.title: Scientist World：把每篇论文变成可执行研究环境
items.desc: 自动提取论文开放问题并复现其方法作为 baseline，AI-Scientist 可直接进入环境迭代。
items.value: AI 科研从"读文献"走向"跑文献"，可评测性大幅提升

items.title: SAE Interprets MoE：稀疏自编码器揭示专家具备可读的细粒度专精
items.desc: 在 MoE 层输出上训练 SAE，从特征空间而非路由频率刻画专家职责。
items.value: 为 MoE 剪枝、专家路由调优提供可解释依据

items.title: Muir：线性注意力引入敏感度分配门控与匹配滤波读出
items.desc: 指出状态更新对"擦除"的敏感度远低于"写入"，据此重新分配门控容量。
items.value: 长上下文线性注意力架构的可改进方向，训练更省显存

items.title: 相同训练不同越狱：25 组预训练配方 × 多随机种子共 150 个模型
items.desc: 同一数据与安全后训练下，不同预训练种子被攻破的越狱集不同。
items.value: 单 checkpoint 越狱评测结论不可外推，安全评估方法需修订

items.title: Cloudflare 开源 security-audit-skill
items.desc: 面向编码 Agent 的多阶段安全审计技能，产出可独立验证、机器可读的发现项，单日涨 2548 star。
items.value: Agent 安全审计有了标准化技能包，可直接接入现有编码工作流

items.title: Ripple-65B Preview：完全 Apache 2.0 的美国开源模型
items.desc: 在 TerminalBench 2.1 上取得美国开源模型最高分，总研发成本 3200 万美元，但其他基准落后于 Inkling 2 Small。
items.value: 低成本训练高 Agent 编码能力的路径样本，许可证无附加限制

items.title: Zyphra 开源 ZYFA：AMD MI355X 上的 FP8 FlashAttention
items.desc: 真实模型激活下比 AMD AITER 快 1.16–1.76 倍，head dim 128 时误差低 62–78%。
items.value: AMD 推理栈可用性提升，非 NVIDIA 部署的成本优势变实在

items.title: Together Compiler：Agent 驱动推理编译，最高 2.6 倍加速
items.desc: 随流量变化持续重优化前向计算，单模型 24 小时内超过最优 InferenceX 配置。
items.value: 推理优化从人工调参转为持续自动编译，可直接降低服务成本

items.title: Google 与 Meta 在 PyTorch 大会开源 TorchTPU
items.desc: 在 TPU 上原生支持 PyTorch。
items.value: PyTorch 生态首次原生打通 TPU，硬件迁移成本大幅下降

items.title: NVIDIA 发布 Cosmos 3 开放模型系列
items.desc: 面向交互式世界仿真。
items.value: 机器人/自动驾驶的仿真数据生成有了新的开放基座

items.title: 开源模型正在削弱网络安全与逆向工程能力，本地模型用户强烈反弹
items.desc: r/LocalLLaMA 讨论指出 Kimi K3.1 与腾讯 Hy4 均移除了网络安全、逆向与漏洞修补能力，认为这会迫使用户转向闭源模型，无法审计自有代码。
items.value: 开源模型的安全对齐策略正与本地部署需求直接冲突，选型需提前验证

items.title: "AI 正在显著加速 AI 研究"引发 HN 长讨论
items.desc: 168 分、131 条评论，与 METR 对 Anthropic 的审计结论相互呼应，争论焦点是加速是否可测量、以及是否已越过安全阈值。
items.value: 递归自我改进从口号变成可讨论的工程与治理问题

en.headline: OpenAI valued at $1.25T, Anthropic IPO hits snag
headline_alt: Two open-source giants release models same day, Western open-source leaderboard changes hands
AI capital frenzy and cooling usage spending appear together
en.observation: Today's core signal is that "capital enthusiasm and usage spending are starting to decouple": OpenAI continues to attract funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, while Anthropic's IPO pricing has been pushed down by buyers to $1.1 trillion, and Ramp data shows enterprise AI spending has stalled—price cuts and cost controls are offsetting growth in call volume. On the technical side, two major Western open-source models appeared on the same day (Inkling 2 Small and Ripple-65B), and TorchTPU connects PyTorch with TPU, so both weights and hardware are becoming more optional. More concerning is METR's audit conclusion: AI-assisted R&D has roughly doubled Anthropic's iteration speed, while key evidence was redacted—meaning "self-acceleration" is shifting from speculation to an infrastructure problem that requires external audit capability. For developers, the most practical short-term change is that inference costs keep falling (Gemini Omni is 30% cheaper, Together Compiler is 2.6x faster), but the deliberate trimming of safety capabilities in open-source models will make local deployment choices more complicated.

items.title: OpenAI raises another $11 billion, valuation climbs to $1.25 trillion
items.desc: The new round is not yet closed and is expected to wrap up within weeks; it comes just over half a year after a $852 billion valuation in March.
items.value: Capital barriers for top model companies rise further, resetting startup fundraising benchmarks

items.title: Anthropic IPO valuation expectations drop from $1.5 trillion to $1.1 trillion
items.desc: Investors are pushing prices down amid an AI sector selloff, with clear disagreement between underwriters and buyers on pricing.
items.value: Primary-market pricing of model companies is diverging, giving bubble talk data support

items.title: Ramp data: AI usage keeps rising, but enterprise spending stalls
items.desc: Price cuts and cost controls offset growth in calls, directly challenging the investment assumption of "hypergrowth AI."
items.value: Token-billed products must reassess ARPU and growth models

items.title: Perplexity launches always-on Agent "Teammates"
items.desc: The Agent runs on a separate virtual machine to push long-term projects forward; it requires the $200/month Max plan, priced above similar OpenAI and Anthropic products.
items.value: The always-on Agent field is crowded; pricing and task persistence become differentiators

items.title: Meta launches Spaces for Muse Agent
items.desc: Users can generate and directly interact with customized app-like interfaces inside Muse, such as shopping malls, school dashboards, and music trackers.
items.value: Agents move from conversation to "generating mini-apps," a new product-form sample

items.title: After US midterms, AI and data centers become political focus
items.desc: Democrats launch congressional investigations into SpaceXAI, Meta, and Apple; 40 of 41 data center ballot measures pass restrictive clauses.
items.value: Compliance and community resistance to compute expansion will materially affect training and inference costs

items.title: OpenAI says data center projects will no longer use NDAs with officials
items.desc: It makes community commitments after the midterms, responding to criticism that NDAs hid negotiations.
items.value: Data center siting becomes more transparent, possibly becoming an industry default

items.title: Microsoft scales back AI cloud capacity rental deal with Oracle
items.desc: The large order signed earlier to ease compute shortages is starting to taper off.
items.value: Cloud compute supply-demand shows signs of loosening, affecting GPU rental pricing expectations

items.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy Agent security company Clutch for $500 million
items.desc: Clutch's previous round valued it at only $85 million.
items.value: Agent security becomes a standalone category, with a big-company premium acquisition validating demand

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber, combining offense and defense
items.desc: It found 81 previously unknown vulnerabilities in Firefox, built 948 usable exploits in the Linux kernel, and provided patch suggestions.
items.value: Security audit and vulnerability discovery workflows will be rebuilt; defenders must reassess threat models

items.title: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.desc: Video generation extends to 15 seconds, supports multi-turn conversational editing, and 720p pricing drops to $0.07 per second, a 30% cut.
items.value: Unit costs for video generation keep falling, opening margin room for short dramas and ads

items.title: METR audit says Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning line in July
items.desc: An 11-week audit shows its model R&D speed roughly doubled, with about 80% of the acceleration from AI-assisted research; key evidence was redacted by Anthropic.
items.value: AI accelerating AI R&D moves from rumor to auditable data; verifiability of safety pledges is questioned

items.title: EU text watermarking rules take effect, OpenAI textGrain may struggle to comply
items.desc: Tests show watermarks often fail when text is re-edited or under 150 words, and there is no clear legal baseline.
items.value: Compliant watermarking is immature; overseas products need in-house text provenance

items.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small: 594B MoE, 17B active
items.desc: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score of 31, supports image input and variable reasoning effort, plans to release open weights under Apache 2.0, and can run on Tinker.
items.value: A new ceiling for Western open-weight models, but token usage rises notably, so cost must be weighed

items.title: OpenAI releases BioBasicsBench
items.desc: 100 tasks measuring agents' ability to interpret raw experimental data and handle routine wet-lab work.
items.value: Gives "AI doing experiments" a reproducible eval; bio agents now have a benchmark

items.title: Scientist World: turning every paper into an executable research environment
items.desc: Automatically extracts open questions from papers and reproduces their methods as baselines, so AI-Scientist can enter the environment and iterate directly.
items.value: AI research moves from "reading papers" to "running papers," greatly improving evaluability

items.title: SAE Interprets MoE: sparse autoencoders reveal experts have readable fine-grained specialization
items.desc: Trains SAEs on MoE layer outputs, characterizing expert roles from feature space rather than routing frequency.
items.value: Provides interpretable grounds for MoE pruning and expert routing tuning

items.title: Muir: linear attention introduces sensitivity-allocated gating and matched-filter readout
items.desc: Finds that state updates are far less sensitive to "erase" than to "write," and reallocates gating capacity accordingly.
items.value: An improvable direction for long-context linear attention architectures, with lower memory cost in training

items.title: Same training, different jailbreaks: 25 pretraining recipes × multiple random seeds, 150 models total
items.desc: Under the same data and safety post-training, different pretraining seeds are broken by different jailbreak sets.
items.value: Jailbreak eval conclusions from a single checkpoint do not generalize; safety evaluation methods need revision

items.title: Cloudflare open-sources security-audit-skill
items.desc: A multi-stage security audit skill for coding agents that produces independently verifiable, machine-readable findings; gained 2,548 stars in a single day.
items.value: Standardized skill pack lets agents plug security audits into existing coding workflows

items.title: Ripple-65B Preview: a fully Apache 2.0 US open model
items.desc: Scored highest among US open models on TerminalBench 2.1 with total R&D cost of $32M, but trails Inkling 2 Small on other benchmarks.
items.value: Shows a low-cost path to strong agentic coding, with no license restrictions

items.title: Zyphra open-sources ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention on AMD MI355X
items.desc: 1.16–1.76x faster than AMD AITER under real model activations, with 62–78% lower error at head dim 128.
items.value: Makes AMD inference stacks more viable, realizing real cost advantages over NVIDIA

items.title: Together Compiler: agent-driven inference compilation, up to 2.6x speedup
items.desc: Continuously re-optimizes forward computation as traffic shifts, beating the best InferenceX config within 24 hours on a single model.
items.value: Shifts inference optimization from manual tuning to continuous auto-compilation, cutting serving costs

items.title: Google and Meta open-source TorchTPU at PyTorch Conference
items.desc: Native PyTorch support on TPUs.
items.value: First native PyTorch-TPU integration sharply lowers hardware migration costs

items.title: NVIDIA releases Cosmos 3 open model family
items.desc: Aimed at interactive world simulation.
items.value: Gives robotics and autonomous driving a new open base for simulation data

items.title: Open-source models are weakening cybersecurity and reverse-engineering capabilities, drawing strong backlash from local model users
items.desc: A discussion on r/LocalLLaMA points out that Kimi K3.1 and Tencent Hy4 have both removed cybersecurity, reverse-engineering, and vulnerability-patching capabilities, arguing this will force users toward closed-source models and leave them unable to audit their own code.
items.value: Open-source safety alignment now directly conflicts with local deployment needs; verify before choosing

items.title: "AI is dramatically accelerating AI research" sparks a long HN discussion
items.desc: 168 points and 131 comments, echoing METR's audit findings on Anthropic; the debate centers on whether the acceleration is measurable and whether it has crossed safety thresholds.
items.value: Recursive self-improvement shifts from slogan to a tractable engineering and governance problem
